messages.author: ba38913179b72011
messages.subject: Error in lav_standardize_all()
parts:
Hi all,


I am trying to do SEM analysis with multi-imputed data.

Since the latest versions of lavaan, I cannot obtain the standardized coefficients:


> summary(fitsem, standardized=T)
Error in lav_standardize_all(object, est = est, GLIST = GLIST, partable = partable,  : 
  no slot of name "SampleStats" for this object of class "lavaan.mi"

 

How to obtain these coefficients?


Many thanks.


Gena


Versions of lavaan and semtools used:

semTools_0.4-15.930 lavaan_0.6-2.1259

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Error in lav_standardize_all()
parts: Since the latest versions of lavaan, I cannot obtain the standardized coefficients:

Indeed, you can get them with the version of lavaan on CRAN, but the development version changed the internal standardization functions.  I found the source of the problem and suggested a fix.  You can track it here, to see if / when Yves accepts the change, at which point you can re-install the development version of lavaan to solve the problem.

https://github.com/yrosseel/lavaan/pull/105

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
UvA web page: http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
